items.quote: Ihre Kündigung muss uns vor diesem Tag in Textform erreichen; Kosten entstehen Ihnen dadurch nicht.
items.computation: The price increase takes effect 'zum 01.01.2027' (letter heading and body). The letter grants a special right to terminate without notice effective that same date, but requires the termination to arrive at the provider 'vor diesem Tag' (before that day), i.e. before 2027-01-01. The last day it can still arrive in time is therefore 2026-12-31 (a Thursday, no weekend/holiday adjustment needed since this is a contractually fixed calendar deadline, not a statutory period subject to §193 BGB extension).
